source: Direct request to remove misleading obsolete design material, planning selections, and explicit implementation of the cleanup plan
ownerImplementationStatement: PLEASE IMPLEMENT THIS PLAN: Remove obsolete design material and consolidate the repository

decisions.currentAuthority: docs/design/current/ with all eight R3 references for visual style and approved page contracts/corrections for UX
decisions.removeObsoleteMaterial: Remove exactly the obsolete specifications, captures, review demos, catalogs, exporters and dedicated tests listed in the cleanup manifest; recover removed material from Git history instead of retaining a checkout archive
decisions.preserveReferenceBundles: All 223 files in the seven accepted R3-R10 bundles remain at their original paths with unchanged bytes, including internal drafts and generation records
decisions.preserveCurrentContracts: Retain all 11 current contract files; only obsolete references and cleanup routing wording may change
decisions.preserveImplementedWork: Keep implemented app/native behavior, meaningful tests, schemas, backup readers, preview/deployment tooling, unrelated backlog tasks and supporting evidence
decisions.staticBranding: Preserve the exact Classic source crop and icon board under assets/brand/reference/; keep the associated supplied source board; no production icon replacement in this cleanup
decisions.replacementPullRequest: Create and attach the replacement before closing and unlinking PR #5; no force push or history rewrite
decisions.branchNaming: Do not create or continue implementation on codex-prefixed branches

supersedes: A36's archive and obsolete submission preservation policy only; A36's current appearance, scope and design decisions remain in force
limits: No new UI implementation, artwork generation, production icon export, device installation or physical alarm verification
No runtime API, persistence, scheduling, backup format or preference migration
R9 remains draft; the list-icon treatment remains an explicit implementation review question
Preserve any newly discovered ambiguous file and ask the owner before expanding the authorized removal manifest
